Begin Function { }
let rA := GetFormFromMod "FalloutNV.esm" "15169"
let rB := GetFormFromMod "FalloutNV.esm" "F"
let rC := GetFormFromMod "FalloutNV.esm" "434F"
let aList := Ar_List rA, rB, rC
let aOut := Ar_SortEditor aList
let rA := aOut[0]
let rB := aOut[1]
let rC := aOut[2]
let sText := sv_Construct "%z %z %z" (GetFormIDString rA) (GetFormIDString rB) (GetFormIDString rC)
let aOut := Ar_SortEditor aList 1
let rA := aOut[0]
let rB := aOut[1]
let rC := aOut[2]
SetFunctionValue (sv_Construct "%z | %z %z %z" sText (GetFormIDString rA) (GetFormIDString rB) (GetFormIDString rC))
End
